@@U00461@@
Ah, but there’s another small matter,
if you don’t mind!
Just to cover all contingencies,
do you think you could manage a few lines in writing?

@@U00463@@
Is the written word the only thing
with meaning for you, you pedant?
Have you never known a man who was
true to his word? Isn’t my word
enough to dispose of my days to all eternity?
Oh, I know!
You see the world flow past like a raging torrent,
and wonder why a mere promise should bind me.
But that’s the way we are.
It’s an illusion we cherish and refuse to resign.
It’s inscribed in every heart. It keeps us honest,
keeps us clear and pure spirited and responsible,
and no sacrifice in its name is too great.
But a parchment signed and sealed
is a ghost that everyone dreads.
The written word dies as the ink dries,
and leather and sealing wax tyrannize us.
So what do you want of me, you devil?
Bronze, marble, parchment, paper?
Name it.
The choice is yours.

@@U00465@@
Oh, come now, let’s not overdo it, shall we?
Is all that rhetoric necessary?
Any scrap of paper will do—
and sign it with a drop of blood.

@@U00467@@
Fine.
translation:
@@U00461@@
啊，不过还有一个小问题，
如果你不介意的话！
只为应付一切意外情况，
你认为你能写几行字吗？

@@U00463@@
文字是唯一的东西吗
对你来说有意义吗，你这个学究？
你是否从未认识过一个男人
言出必行吗？这不是我的话吗
足以让我的日子永远消失吗？
哦，我知道！
你看世界像汹涌的洪流一样流过，
并想知道为什么仅仅一个承诺就能束缚我。
但我们就是这样。
这是我们珍惜并拒绝放弃的幻想。
它铭刻在每个人心中。它让我们保持诚实，
让我们保持清醒、纯洁、有精神、有责任心，
以它的名义做出的任何牺牲都不算太大。
但有一张羊皮纸签名并盖章
是一个人人都害怕的鬼。
书写的文字随着墨水的干涸而消失，
皮革和封蜡对我们来说是一种暴虐。
那么你想要我做什么，你这个恶魔？
青铜、大理石、羊皮纸、纸？
命名它。
选择权在你。

@@U00465@@
哦，来吧，我们不要做得太过分，好吗？
那些言辞有必要吗？
任何一张纸片都可以——
并用一滴血签名。

@@U00467@@
很好。
